one_line: A master sthapati (architect-builder) of Meenakshi Temple in medieval Madurai.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but strong craftsman’s build
appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown Tamil complexion, sharp observant eyes, neatly trimmed black moustache, a single vertical white vibhuti line with a small red dot on the forehead, default expression focused yet calm with a hint of pride
appearance.hair: thick black hair tied into a compact low bun at the back of the head, front smoothed back with no loose fringe, wrapped with a narrow off-white cotton headband knotted above the right ear
appearance.costume: era-accurate South Indian artisan attire: a knee-length off-white cotton angavastram draped over the left shoulder and across the torso, paired with a deep indigo cotton veshti (dhoti) wrapped tightly and reaching the ankles with a thin golden border, bare forearms with simple dark wooden bangles, feet in plain brown leather sandals; fabric looks handwoven, subtly textured, with no elaborate patterns except the dhoti border.
appearance.signature: a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a thin red cotton cord, tucked under his left arm, accompanied by a simple wooden measuring rod held in his right hand

ref_desc: Madurai Vishwakarma is a mid-30s Tamil sthapati with an oval medium-brown face, low-bun black hair and off-white headband, wearing an off-white angavastram and deep indigo golden-bordered veshti, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript and wooden measuring rod in warm off-white, indigo, brown, gold, and red tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of a medieval South Indian temple architect-builder in Madurai: a mid-30s Tamil man with an oval medium-brown face, sharp eyes, neat black moustache, and a single vertical white vibhuti line with a small red dot on his forehead. His thick black hair is tied into a compact low bun at the back, wrapped with a narrow off-white cotton headband knotted above the right ear. He wears an off-white cotton angavastram draped over the left shoulder and across the chest and back, along with a deep indigo cotton veshti (dhoti) wrapped tightly, ankle-length, with a thin golden border, and simple brown leather sandals; the fabrics should look handwoven with subtle texture and no pattern beyond the dhoti border. His forearms are bare except for simple dark wooden bangles. In his left arm he tucks a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a thin red cotton cord, and in his right hand he holds a straight wooden measuring rod, shown clearly. Use a clean, dignified shonen-anime look with dominant colours of off-white, deep indigo, warm brown, golden yellow and touches of deep red, and present him front-facing in a neutral stance so his face, hairstyle, draped garments, sandals, and tools are all fully visible and easy to redraw consistently.
